CALLS.DESCRIPTION: Manage Twilio call queues for editions and generic queues (support, HR, sales).

EDITION_QUEUES.TITLE: Edition Queues
EDITION_QUEUES.DESCRIPTION: Editions appear in the phone menu automatically when the event is live. Assign agents to receive calls.
EDITION_QUEUES.NAME: Edition

GENERIC_QUEUES.TITLE: Generic Queues
GENERIC_QUEUES.DESCRIPTION: Fallback queues for support, HR, and sales calls.

EDITION_DETAIL.NAME: Name
EDITION_DETAIL.EMPTY: No agents assigned to this edition.

PRIORITY.LABEL: Priority
PRIORITY.HELP: Lower number = called first (0 is highest priority)

SHOW_CALLER_ID.LABEL: Show Caller ID
SHOW_CALLER_ID.HELP: Show the real caller number to the agent

DELETE_AGENT.TITLE: Remove Agent
DELETE_AGENT.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to remove this agent from the queue?

OPENING_HOURS.TITLE: Opening Hours
OPENING_HOURS.DESCRIPTION: Set when this queue accepts calls
OPENING_HOURS.SUPPORT_NOTE: Support hours act as the global gate — if support is closed, all incoming calls are rejected.
OPENING_HOURS.RESET_CONFIRM: Remove custom hours? This edition will inherit support queue hours.
OPENING_HOURS.NOT_CONFIGURED: No hours configured — queue is always open.

EXCEPTIONS.TITLE: Date Exceptions
EXCEPTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Override hours for specific dates (holidays, events)

AGENTS.DESCRIPTION: Manage agents who receive Twilio calls. Agents can be assigned to multiple queues and editions.
AGENTS.NAME: Name
AGENTS.DELETE_MESSAGE: This will remove the agent and all their queue/edition assignments. This cannot be undone.

API.HOURS_RESET: Custom hours removed — inheriting from support
API.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
